description: Golden fixtures for Immunity/Weakness/Resistance (IWR) pipeline (PF2e Remaster).

rules.immunity: Ignores the damage type completely (result = 0 for that type).
rules.weakness: Add weakness value to total damage after immunity check.
rules.resistance: Subtract resistance value from total damage (minimum 0).
rules.postCrit: Weaknesses and resistances apply AFTER critical hit multiplication.
rules.source: §6.4: 'Ordem de aplicação: Imunidade → Fraqueza → Resistência'; 'Fraquezas e resistências se aplicam ao dano após qualquer multiplicação de critical hit'

cases.description: Immunity: damage of immune type is reduced to 0
cases.rule: §6.4: Immunity — ignora completamente o dano do tipo

cases.description: Weakness: adds weakness value to damage
cases.rule: §6.4: Weakness X [tipo] — adiciona X ao dano total (10 + 5 = 15)
§6.4: Resistance X [tipo] — reduz dano em X (10 − 5 = 5)
§6.4: Resistance — 'reduz dano do tipo indicado em X (mínimo 0)'; 3 − 10 floored at 0

cases.description: Weakness + Resistance of same type: weakness applied first (adds), then resistance subtracts
cases.rule: §6.4: Immunity→Weakness→Resistance order; weakness adds: 10+5=15; then resistance subtracts: 15-3=12

cases.description: Immunity takes priority: immune type, also has weakness — immunity wins
cases.rule: §6.4: Immunity is first in pipeline — if immune, damage is 0 before weakness is ever considered

cases.description: Critical hit: damage already doubled, THEN weakness/resistance apply

damage.note: already doubled for crit (was 10 before doubling)

cases.rule: §6.4: 'Fraquezas e resistências se aplicam ao dano após qualquer multiplicação de critical hit'; 20 (doubled) + 5 weakness = 25

cases.description: Critical hit with resistance: resistance applies after doubling
Multiple damage types: each resolved independently through IWR
cases.rule: §6.4: each damage type goes through IWR independently; piercing 10+5=15; fire 5→0 (immunity)
§6.1 + §6.4: physical damage types (bludgeoning/piercing/slashing) are targeted by 'physical' resistance; 15 − 5 = 10
cases.verifyNote: Confirm engine-2e treats 'physical' as an umbrella target covering all three physical damage subtypes, consistent with PF2e stat block conventions.

cases.description: Persistent damage basic: tracked separately, applied at end of turn

expected.note: persistent damage still goes through IWR (weakness applies: 5 + 5 = 10)

cases.rule: §6.5 + §6.4: persistent damage is applied at end of turn; it still interacts with IWR (weakness/resistance apply)
cases.verifyNote: PF2e RAW states persistent damage triggers weakness/resistance. Confirm the engine IWR pipeline is called when persistent damage fires.

cases.description: Weakness to a trait (e.g., 'magical'): applies when damage has that trait
cases.rule: §6.4: weakness target can be a trait, not just a damage type; 'magical' trait on damage triggers 5 weakness

cases.description: Immunity to a condition (not damage): blocks condition application
cases.rule: §6.4 + REQ-PF2-053: immunity applies to conditions as well; 'frightened' immunity blocks the condition

cases.description: No relevant IWR: damage passes through unchanged
cases.rule: §6.4: none of the IWR entries match 'slashing'; damage is unchanged

cases.description: Zero damage after all IWR: result is 0, not negative
